gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
The bridge has a maximum ___ (WEIGH) of ten tonnes.
She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
He gave me some very useful ___ (ADVISE).
gaps.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable — never 'advices'; 'advise' is the verb.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.

gaps.sentence: The bacteria are ___ (SEE) to the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: 'Invisible' = impossible to see — the negative adjective from VISIBLE/SEE.

gaps.sentence: The law needs complete ___ (REVISE) before it can work.
She gazed at the mural in silent ___ (ADMIRE).
gaps.explanation: 'In silent admiration' — the noun for the feeling.
